message: You're still repeating the same arguments, aren't you? Claiming that my position is a 'house of cards' that will collapse under its own contradictions. You're not engaging in good faith, and your entire argument is based on a straw man. You're not here to discuss, you're here to virtue signal and pretend to be a concerned citizen. Get out of here with your self-righteous posturing and your empty rhetoric. You have no business being in a serious discussion about this or anything else.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'self-righteous' and 'empty rhetoric',  and says they 'have no business' being in the discussion. This is a direct attack on the opponent's character and their right to participate.
